1.text: Hello, I am Doctor Alex. I am an AI-powered virtual character designed to help you explore how clinical trials work so that you feel well-informed when determining whether taking part in one may be appropriate for you.

When considering a clinical trial, having accurate, reliable information is essential. However, there is a great deal of information available, and it can be challenging to know where to look or how to make sense of it all.

My role is to help you navigate that information by drawing from a large collection of trusted medical sources, such as the National Health Institute. These sources were curated by real human health communication experts for this website. From these sources, I identify relevant information to provide clear, evidence-based answers to your questions.

2.text: Hi there, I’m Alex. I am an AI-powered virtual character here to help you understand clinical trial participation. We’ll go through the topics you chose earlier one at a time. My role is to provide information about each topic from trusted health resources, such as the National Cancer Institute.

I'll also help you think about how each topic relates to what matters to you. As we explore each topic, I'll help keep track of questions or concerns you might want to discuss with a healthcare provider or clinical trial team if you ever consider a clinical trial. You can see these anytime by clicking on the question list next to me.

Now, before we get started, please remember that I don’t have access to specific clinical trials, so I can’t search for or answer questions about specific trials or treatments. I also can’t provide medical advice.

If you have questions that depend on a specific clinical trial or your personal situation, I'll save them to your tailored question list so you can revisit them if you ever consider a trial. And after we've covered your three topics, I'll also suggest some useful next steps for you based on what you share during our conversation.

Finally, we can spend as much time as you'd like on each topic. Whenever you're ready to move on, just click the button next to me. Let's try it now! Click the button to get started with your first topic.

3.text: Hi there, I am Doctor Alex, and this is Jordan. We are AI-powered virtual characters here to help you understand clinical trial participation so you can evaluate whether participating in one might be right for you.

When considering a clinical trial, having accurate, reliable information is essential. However, there is a great deal of information available, and it can be challenging to know where to look or how to make sense of it all.

My role is to help you navigate that information by drawing from a large collection of trusted medical sources, such as the National Health Institute. These sources were curated by real human health communication experts for this website. From these sources, I identify relevant information to provide clear, evidence-based answers to your questions.

But even the most reliable information is most useful when it addresses what's important to you! Everyone has different experiences, needs, and concerns, so what matters most can be different for each person. We want to make sure the information you get matches your individual needs.

That's where I come in! My role is to support you in expressing your own needs and concerns. Throughout the conversation, I'll invite you to share your perspectives and help you think through what's important to you, so your voice can guide the information Dr. Alex finds and shares with you.
So, let’s start by learning a little bit about what matters to you so Doctor Alex can help suggest some topics to explore.
Before looking into any particular study, what are the top three things you'd want to understand better or think through to decide whether clinical trials are something you'd want to explore further?
Feel free to share your concerns or anything that would be important to you personally.
